data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Theresa, derived from the Greek word theoreo meaning 'to behold, to contemplate, to worship'. data.cultural_impact: The name Theresina is common in various cultures, such as Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian. The name Theresa has been popular since the Late Middle Ages due to Saint Therese of Avila and Saint Therese of Lisieux.These saints have had a significant impact on the Catholic Church and have inspired countless individuals to deepen their spiritual lives.
